convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() call to 'SilverTrend_Signal' custom indicator which is not a built-in MT5 indicator; requires the custom indicator .ex5 file to replicate signal logic in Python

other_exits: Close opposite position on reverse signal before ReOpen entry

custom_logic_notes: ReOpen logic: EA allows re-entering a position in the same direction after being stopped out or taking profit within the same signal bar/window, as long as the SilverTrend signal remains active. Signal reversal closes the opposite position before opening a new one. The SilverTrend_Signal indicator uses a weighted moving average crossover with volatility filter (RISK parameter controls sensitivity; higher RISK = fewer but more reliable signals). Digit adjustment applies: SL/TP in pips are multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 to normalize to points.
external_dependencies: SilverTrend_Signal.ex5 (custom indicator required for iCustom call)
python_conversion_notes: The SilverTrend_Signal indicator logic must be reverse-engineered or obtained from its .mq5 source. The indicator computes two buffers: buy signals (buffer 0) and sell signals (buffer 1), returning a price level when active or EMPTY_VALUE otherwise. The RISK input (default 3) controls signal sensitivity — it acts as a multiplier on a volatility-based threshold within a weighted MA envelope. Without the indicator source, signal logic cannot be faithfully reproduced. The ReOpen feature means the EA does not block re-entry after SL/TP hit on the same signal — implement by not clearing the signal flag on trade closure. Digit adjustment: multiply SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers.
